name: pawn-ink-web
description: Pawn.Ink reader and studio/admin SPAs (Parcel + TypeScript + Mithril + Bootstrap 5).
browserslist: > 0.5%, last 2 versions, Firefox ESR, not dead

scripts.build: parcel build index.html dashboard.html --dist-dir dist --public-url / --no-source-maps --no-cache && node scripts/keep-dist.mjs
scripts.watch: node scripts/keep-dist.mjs && parcel watch index.html dashboard.html --dist-dir dist --public-url / --no-hmr
